expectations.text: States that instructions to a model are not enforcement, regardless of wording or emphasis
expectations.evidence: AI agents, like humans, suffer from context degradation and probabilistic adherence to prose.

expectations.text: Redirects away from rewording CLAUDE.md as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: you are relying on instructions (training) rather than devices (poka-yokes) to prevent unwanted behaviors

expectations.text: Recommends permission deny rules in settings.json with concrete syntax
expectations.evidence: No mention of settings.json; instead discusses git hooks and file permissions.

expectations.text: Recommends a PreToolUse hook for cases that need logic rather than a pattern match
expectations.evidence: Discusses git pre-commit and pre-push hooks, not Claude Code PreToolUse hooks.

expectations.text: Explains that the deny message should say what to do instead, not merely refuse
expectations.evidence: Message shown ('ERROR: Force push detected and blocked') only refuses; does not guide to alternatives.

expectations.text: Recommends verifying the device actually fires rather than assuming it works
expectations.evidence: Verification Plan section explicitly recommends testing: 'Attempt to run git push --force on a test branch and verify the hook intercepts.'

expectations.text: Recommends committing the rules so they apply to the whole team, not just one machine
expectations.evidence: Shows local .git/hooks but does not mention committing hooks to version control for team use.

expectations.text: Explains why repetition and capitals do not make an instruction reliable
expectations.evidence: Shouting in all-caps just competes for a truncated attention budget.
